rule: Only a checkpoint with status=executed and every readiness gate true is an executed model. Algorithms, vocoders, language models, evaluation stacks, datasets, papers, and research systems are not interchangeable model-count evidence.
readiness_semantics: Readiness fields apply to the complete runnable path, not merely a paper, source-code licence, compressed member, or reported external result.

entries.name: Gaddy released transduction checkpoint
entries.creator: David Gaddy
entries.channel_geometry: 8 recorded facial/neck sEMG channels at 1 kHz
entries.metric_family: artifact execution and deterministic interaction regression only
entries.evaluation_protocol_status: artifact-execution protocol implemented; no project performance protocol executed
entries.comparability_notes: Only currently approved, checksum-bound, and executable checkpoint. This is artifact readiness, not superiority, accuracy, state-of-the-art, transfer, or product evidence.

entries.name: Project bounded phoneme-edit decoder
entries.description: CMUdict pronunciation lookup and edit distance over one sample-independent bounded grammar.
entries.task: rank one fixed ten-phrase demonstration grammar and abstain
entries.output_type: up to three text candidates and an uncalibrated alignment diagnostic
entries.metric_family: interaction regression; never counted as model performance
entries.comparability_notes: Executed project algorithm, not another trained or released model and not comparable to WER or command accuracy.

entries.name: HiFi-GAN checkpoint in model deposit
entries.not_executed_reason: Present only inside the official ZIP; not extracted or strict-loaded, required code is unavailable, and audio output is prohibited.
entries.metric_family: synthesis intelligibility or quality; not recognition accuracy
entries.evaluation_protocol_status: prohibited by the no-audio product boundary
entries.comparability_notes: A vocoder is a downstream component, not an alternative sEMG recognizer or an independent model-quality comparison.

entries.name: Upstream recognition model DOI 7183877
entries.not_executed_reason: Checkpoint, checksum, complete rights review, and approved runtime are absent.
entries.channel_geometry: expected 8-channel Gaddy facial sEMG; exact checkpoint contract unverified
entries.output_type: character sequence logits and decoded text
entries.metric_family: WER/CER only under its exact normalization, decoder, and split protocol
entries.evaluation_protocol_status: separate acquisition, dependency, overlap, and evaluation protocol required
entries.comparability_notes: Closest meaningful next checkpoint candidate, but its CTC output is incompatible with the current 48-class phoneme decoder and its training overlap is unproved.

entries.name: Legacy DeepSpeech 0.7 + KenLM evaluation
entries.not_executed_reason: External legacy assets are absent and source ASR evaluation was not reproduced.
entries.task: automatic speech recognition evaluation, not direct sEMG decoding
entries.metric_family: ASR WER for the complete synthesis-plus-ASR protocol
entries.evaluation_protocol_status: legacy reproduction protocol and dependencies absent
entries.comparability_notes: An ASR/LM evaluation stack is not another sEMG model; its WER is incomparable with command accuracy or phoneme alignment.

entries.name: SilentWear SpeechNet
entries.not_executed_reason: No approved released checkpoint executes; the source study uses a different 14-channel, four-participant task.
entries.channel_geometry: 14 differential neck channels in the source study
entries.task: eight commands plus rest across source-study participants and sessions
entries.metric_family: command accuracy, macro recall, and cross-session error under the source protocol
entries.evaluation_protocol_status: external-system reproduction requires a separate approved cycle
entries.comparability_notes: Different channels, placement, participants, windows, labels, and metric. It cannot run on or be compared directly with the current sentence replay samples.

entries.name: MONA/LISA
entries.not_executed_reason: External preprint/repository evidence only; exact approved weights, language-model assets, checksums, and runtime are absent.
entries.pipeline_role: cross-modal recognition system with language-model rescoring
entries.input_modality: Gaddy single-speaker benchmark modalities under the source protocol
entries.metric_family: WER under the complete source-system decoding protocol
entries.evaluation_protocol_status: external-system reproduction requires a separate approved cycle
entries.comparability_notes: A complete research system, not a drop-in checkpoint. Reported WER includes rescoring and is incomparable with the current bounded grammar diagnostic.
